title: Siren
source: "Survival Guide" (Довідник виживання) 2.3 (CC BY-SA 4.0), sec. 22.1, 3.3; English translation by Sprotyv

steps.action: Siren? Put on shoes, go to a grown-up. No grown-up? Straight to the hallway.
Go together to the hallway or a shelter.
steps.why: In the hallway, two walls are between you and the street.

steps.action: Do not go to the window, not even to look.
Come out only when a grown-up says so or you hear “All clear”.

title: Buzzing in the sky
source: "Survival Guide" (Довідник виживання) 2.3 (CC BY-SA 4.0), sec. 22.1, 4.3; English translation by Sprotyv

steps.action: Buzzing in the sky? Quickly get under a roof: house, stairwell or shop.
steps.why: Do not look up and do not film it on a phone.

steps.action: No roof — crawl deep into thick bushes, lie down and keep still.
Shut the door behind you and go further inside, away from windows.
Do not go out right away. Call your family and wait for what they say.

title: A strange thing
source: "Survival Guide" (Довідник виживання) 2.3 (CC BY-SA 4.0), sec. 5.5; English translation by Sprotyv

steps.action: Not mine — I don't touch it.
steps.why: Even if it looks like a toy or it shines.

steps.action: See a strange thing — quietly step back.
Tell grown-ups. They will only praise you for it.
Do not play in empty buildings, trenches or near broken machines.

title: I can't see my family
source: "Survival Guide" (Довідник виживання) 2.3 (CC BY-SA 4.0), sec. 22.1; English translation by Sprotyv

steps.action: Stay where you are. Do not go anywhere with anyone.
steps.why: A grown-up will look for you. You wait.

steps.action: Shout Mum's or Dad's name loudly. Have a whistle — blow it.
Have a phone — call your family.

title: Smoke or fire
source: "Survival Guide" (Довідник виживання) 2.3 (CC BY-SA 4.0), sec. 10.5, 30.14; English translation by Sprotyv

steps.action: Shout “Fire!” and call grown-ups.
Go out bending low, cloth over your nose and mouth. Don't take the lift.
steps.why: Smoke is more dangerous than fire, and there is less of it down low.

steps.action: Door hot? Thick smoke on the stairs? Shut the door, stand at the window, shout.
steps.why: Do not jump: rescuers will come.

steps.action: Clothes on fire — stop, drop, roll.
Outside, call 112 or your family.
steps.why: 112 works from any phone, even with no money on it.

title: I'm scared
source: "Survival Guide" (Довідник виживання) 2.3 (CC BY-SA 4.0), sec. 22.2, 1.2; English translation by Sprotyv

steps.action: In a safe place now? Sit next to a grown-up or hug your toy.
Breathe in slowly, counting to 4. Breathe out, counting to 6. Do this 10 times.
Ask for a job: hold the torch or count everyone.
steps.why: Doing a job makes you less scared.

title: A call “from Mum”
source: "Survival Guide" (Довідник виживання) 2.3 (CC BY-SA 4.0), sec. 22.1, 18.3; English translation by Sprotyv

steps.action: A stranger calls “from Mum” or “from Dad” — ask for the code word.
steps.why: Only your family knows the code word.

steps.action: Doesn't know the word — hang up.
Call Mum or Dad on their own number.
